title: The build compiles the shared packages from committed source
description: Found as F-37 (MS-2026-0008). packages/platform-sdk/dist is ignored by git and no script builds it. Runtime and Builder typecheck against whatever dist is on disk. The owner's dist was built on 2026-08-16 from a source that said healthScore: number | null; the source was then put back to number and that was never committed, while Runtime commit 18070a12 sets healthScore: null. So the owner's build passes, and a fresh clone fails with 121 Runtime type errors (the SDK cannot be resolved), and 1 once it is built from committed source. knowledge-platform's dist matches its source.
objective: npm run build on a fresh clone builds the shared packages from committed source, and Runtime and Builder typecheck against them.
risks: The rebuilt SDK must produce the same types the owner's build has today, so Runtime and Builder behaviour does not change.
npm run dev on a fresh clone still needs npm run build:packages first.
